posts.title: Why They’re Building Muse
posts.description: “We built Muse to help people build the world they want.” — Alexandr Wang of Meta Most people never say what they want. It’s not because we don’t want. We want fiercely and constantly. We may not say it, but we do type it. Not directly, but it’s implied in every search we make. Every post we thumbs-up. Every video we linger on.
